quotes.text: With the Sendwave app, you can quickly send funds from debit cards and prepaid cards to mobile wallets, bank accounts, and cash pick-up locations.
We always safeguard your funds while they're in transit to your recipients.
Recipients will receive a text message for GCash and cash pickup.

The cost of your transfer primarily depends on a few things: the currencies involved; how you pay for the transfer (bank transfer, debit card, wallet, etc.); how your recipient receives the transfer (bank deposit, mobile money, cash pickup, etc.); the amount you send.
